intent: Carry changed-work control into a restart gate where verbal authority, instruction fidelity, and verified field state are separated, then show the actual restart outcome.

stages.purpose: establish what the changed-work response left behind
decide how to authorize restart under schedule pressure
verify whether the restart instruction matched the actual control state

presentation_rules: Separate who said restart from whether field controls were actually closed.
Expose the time, information, and verification tradeoffs of every restart route without adding a correct-answer badge.
When restart_result is written, update the same 14:11 panel from verification focus to restart verdict.
